assumptions.choice: Long/short setups are tracked via persistent boolean flags (long_armed/short_armed) set when RSI moves beyond the lower/upper band, and cleared only when the subsequent RSI/SMA20 crossover triggers entry; flags are evaluated only while no position is open.
assumptions.reason: The spec describes a two-stage sequential condition ('X and then Y') across bars rather than a single-bar event, so a persistent flag is the literal way to express the 'and then' carry-over.

assumptions.choice: Implemented as a manual equivalent of a bracket order instead of buy_bracket()/sell_bracket(): the entry is a plain market order, then in notify_order (Completed) the actual fill price is used to submit a separate Stop order at entry_price*0.98 (long) or entry_price*1.02 (short); this stop order is canceled if the RSI/SMA20 exit condition fires first.
assumptions.reason: buy_bracket()/sell_bracket() require the stop price at order-submission time, but a market entry's fill price is only known after execution; the spec explicitly permits 'bracket orders or an equivalent mechanism'.

assumptions.choice: The protective stop order's size is explicitly set to self.position.size rather than left to the default sizer.
assumptions.reason: The stop order must exactly offset the open position to fully exit it; this is a functional requirement of the protective stop, not a sizing preference, so canonical default #1 (no size argument) is applied only to entries.

assumptions.choice: Entry orders use plain self.buy()/self.sell() with no size argument (default sizer).
assumptions.reason: Canonical default #1; the spec is silent on position sizing.

assumptions.choice: 'RSI falls below the lower band' / 'RSI rises above the upper band' are interpreted as a level check each bar (RSI[0] < lower_band[0] / RSI[0] > upper_band[0]), not a cross-detection indicator.
assumptions.reason: Only the SMA20 trigger is explicitly described as a 'cross' in the spec; the band conditions are described as simple state comparisons.
